research_rationale:
EO 12458 (49 FR 1977, signed 1984-01-14; held official Federal Register text) amends Executive Order 12163 (Administration of Foreign Assistance and Related Functions) in three sections. Section 1 adds paragraphs (23), (24) and (25) at the end of section 1-201(a); section 2 amends section 1-301(a) and (c) by replacing '(except chapters 4 and 6 thereof)' with '(except chapters 4, 6 and 8 thereof)'; section 3 amends section 1-801(b) in the same way and section 1-801(c) by replacing 'chapter 6' with 'chapters 6 and 8'. The dossier inventory (headings and subsections) is restated as seven clauses cut from the held text: the three paragraphs of section 1, subsections (a) and (c) of section 2 and subsections (b) and (c) of section 3, with each section's lead-in included in its first clause. Each clause is an amending command performed on issuance; what matters for 2026-10-14 is whether the amended text of EO 12163 still contained the words it inserted. The amended targets were changed by later held orders. (1) EO 12560 (51 FR 19159, signed 1986-05-24; no separate effective-date clause) section 2 amends section 1-201(a) 'by deleting paragraphs (7), (22), (23), (25), (26), and (27), renumbering the remaining paragraphs accordingly'. EO 12458 had added (23) to (25) at the end of a list that ran to (22), so on that date (23) (section 512 of the 1982 appropriations act) and (25) (the El Salvador and Haiti functions under Public Law 98-151) were the paragraphs EO 12458 added, and they were deleted; that identification rests on the paragraph numbering stated in the held orders. Paragraph (24) (chapter 8 of part II of the Act) was not deleted by that order and was renumbered. (2) EO 13118 (64 FR 16595, signed 1999-03-31; 'shall become effective as of April 1, 1999') section 2 restates Part 1-2 of EO 12163 (which contains section 1-201) 'to read as follows' as the United States Agency for International Development part, with no paragraph on chapter 8 of part II; no held order between 1984 and 1999 names the section 573(d)(3) proviso of paragraph (24). Paragraph (24) therefore ended on 1999-04-01 when Part 1-2 was restated. (3) EO 12560 section 8 (1986-05-24) restates section 1-301(c) to read in full, keeping the words 'except chapters 4, 6, and 8 thereof'; EO 13118 section 3 then strikes 'part II of the Act (except chapters 4, 6, and 8 thereof)' from section 301(c) and inserts 'chapters 2 and 5 of part II of the Act', effective 1999-04-01, which ended section 2(c) of EO 12458. (4) EO 13118 section 8 restates Part 1-8 (which contains section 1-801) to read as follows, with a new section 1-800 that has no '(except chapters ...)' wording, effective 1999-04-01, ending section 3(a) and (b) of EO 12458. (5) Section 1-301(a) of EO 12163: no held order strikes or restates subsection (a); other held orders add or rewrite subsections (c), (e), (f), (g) and (h) only, and EO 13118 section 3 amends subsection (c) only. Section 2(a) of EO 12458 therefore remains the only clause whose effect persists, and it is the continuing predicate. Executive Order 12292 (1981-02-23) section 8 revoked paragraph (14) of section 1-201(a), but it predates EO 12458 and does not touch any paragraph EO 12458 added, so it is not a later event. Limits stated plainly: no consolidated text of EO 12163 is held (the U.S. Code note held in the packet only lists the amending orders and is a custody-record-only source), so the current wording of section 1-301(a) is inferred from the held amending orders; EO 12163 itself is not shown revoked (a 2014 order amends it).
